lines.en: Yumi, for reasons beyond my comprehension, answers my call and agrees to meet up with me in the old district for an hour or two.
lines.zh: Yumi 出于我无法理解的原因接了我的电话，同意到老城区和我待上一两个小时。

lines.en: Considering that I’ll be with her for about the same amount of time as my walk to actually get there, I don’t see it as a solid investment of time, but it’s not like I have anything else going on tonight.
lines.zh: 考虑到我跟她待在一起的时间，大概跟我走到那儿花的时间差不多，我不觉得这是对时间的稳妥投资——不过反正我今晚也没别的事。

lines.en: Once I arrive, the two of us do laps around the neighborhood surrounding Chika’s house, being careful to not actually pass Chika’s house, as Yumi remains adamant about remaining hidden.
lines.zh: 等我到了之后，我们俩绕着 Chika 家附近的街区转圈，小心地不去真正经过 Chika 家，因为 Yumi 仍然坚持要藏着不被人看见。

lines.en: And even though I can’t imagine anything happening tonight, or that half of us even want anything to happen, it’s interesting to me just how important this temporary privacy is to her.
lines.zh: 虽然我想象不出今晚会发生什么，甚至觉得我们两个里有一半人根本不希望发生什么，但这份暂时的隐私对她有多重要，倒是让我觉得很有意思。

lines.en: Of course, I can only imagine how bad it would be for everyone involved if Chika were to find out her best friend was seeing her “boyfriend” behind her back, platonic or not.
lines.zh: 当然，如果 Chika 发现她最好的朋友背着她跟她的“男朋友”见面——不管有没有肉体关系——我能想象那对所有当事人会有多糟。

lines.en: And of course I know there’s likely a little more behind Yumi’s reasoning than this alone.
lines.zh: 我当然也知道，Yumi 这么想，背后大概还有比这更多的原因。

lines.en: But I will push that reasoning aside for now, as in this moment, my greatest concern is the same as the one belonging to the girl I came here to see.
lines.zh: 但眼下我会把这个念头推到一边，因为此刻我最关心的，和我来这儿要见的那个女孩所关心的，是一样的。

lines.en: The one who does not yet rely on me.
lines.zh: 那个还不依赖我的女孩。
那个想要依赖我的女孩。
Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!
